observations.behavior: Adds a workflow and comment script for Desktop React Doctor, an advisory-only static analysis tool.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow to run react-doctor on desktop PRs and post a summary comment; the workflow is advisory and does not fail the PR.

observations.behavior: Adds a comment and workflow configuration for Desktop React Doctor.
observations.code_quote: # Point this to the desktop tree to use the local version of your @posthog/agent package instead of the published version. This is useful for testing changes to the agent package locally without needing to publish a new version. The desktop source lives in this repo at products/desktop; an out-of-tree PostHog/code checkout also works.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates documentation for LOCAL_POSTHOG_CODE_MONOREPO_ROOT to point to the desktop tree, supporting local development and testing of the agent against the desktop app.

observations.behavior: Adds a new process entry for desktop in mprocs.yaml.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a process entry for desktop, allowing it to be started alongside other services in the development environment.

observations.behavior: Removes the 'Merging PRs' section and its Trunk merge queue instructions from AGENTS.md, which described a queue in the source repo, not the monorepo.
observations.code_quote: All merges into `main` go through the Trunk merge queue. Never run `gh pr merge` or click the GitHub merge button -- both are blocked by branch ruleset.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that the desktop app's development workflow does not use the source repo's Trunk queue; prevents agents from following incorrect merge instructions.

observations.behavior: Adds a NOTE to CONTRIBUTING.md and README.md directing contributors to the monorepo location and setup, removing the standalone clone path.
observations.code_quote: This is the source for the PostHog desktop and mobile apps and the agent framework that powers them.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the README to clarify the monorepo location and setup, helping contributors avoid cloning the standalone repo.

observations.behavior: Adds a NOTE to LOCAL-DEVELOPMENT.md, skipping the standalone clone and providing commands to run the app from the monorepo, including a Node 22 caveat.
observations.code_quote: Already working in the posthog/posthog monorepo? Skip the clone: the app lives at `products/desktop`. Note it needs Node 22 (see `.node-version`), not the Node version the monorepo's flox environment provides, so switch with your version manager first.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a streamlined development path for contributors already in the monorepo, avoiding unnecessary cloning and version mismatches.
